subject.title: Claude account suspended after roughly half a day with CodexBar running (v0.45.2, Auto source)

question: Should CodexBar continue to auto-select delegated Claude OAuth polling until a maintainer confirms that the active request pattern is within Anthropic’s supported third-party boundary?
rationale: The account-suspension report is safety-relevant but causal attribution is unresolved, so the tradeoff between monitoring convenience and provider-policy caution needs explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Pause delegated Auto polling
options.body: Temporarily make the delegated OAuth path opt-in or unavailable in Auto while the request audit and provider-boundary review are completed.

options.title: Keep current behavior with disclosure
options.body: Retain the current Auto selection only after documenting exact request paths and showing an explicit warning before credential reuse.

options.title: Collect more diagnostics first
options.body: Request redacted source-resolution and request-cadence diagnostics before changing behavior, accepting continued uncertainty in the interim.

recommendation.title: Pause delegated Auto polling
recommendation.body: Temporarily make the delegated OAuth path opt-in or unavailable in Auto while the request audit and provider-boundary review are completed.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged work on the adjacent Claude usage-probe behavior provides the clearest available ownership signal.
